description: GRID3 COD - Roads v1.0 is a data set listed in GRID3 Data Hub, a geospatial data hub, published or maintained by Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN). For more information on the methodology and data sources used during the production of this data, click here. Dataset citation Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University. 2026. GRID3 COD - Roads v1.0. New York: Columbia University. Accessed. Coverage: Democratic Republic of the Congo. The portal files it under the publisher Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN). Its tags are Democratic Republic of the Congo, COD, Roads. The portal shows 2026-03-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0 (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-grid3-portal.
